name: Home, the file list (PDF filter)

regions_read.verdict_on_region: names the app, not the place

regions_read.text: PDF / HWP / Word / Excel / PPT pill row (selected: PDF)
regions_read.verdict_on_region: a file-type filter on the list, not a place in the app; its visible selection says which files are listed, not which section you are in

regions_read.text: Home / Recent / Favorite / Tools tab bar (selected: Home)
regions_read.verdict_on_region: locates the user: 'Home' is drawn with a filled black icon and dark label while the other three are grey outlines; contains_selected_view: true with selected_item_text "Home"

identifier_found: "Home" -- the highlighted item of the bottom tab bar (filled icon, dark label); the top header "PDF Reader" is the app's name
initial_rationale: the header names only the app, but the bottom tab bar visibly highlights Home

test_cases.precondition: Home open, tab bar showing Home highlighted
test_cases.action: tap Recent, then Favorite, then Tools, then Home, watching the tab bar and the top header
test_cases.expected_result: the highlight moves to each tapped tab, or it stays on Home
test_cases.confirms_if: the filled icon and dark label move to each tapped tab
test_cases.overturns_if: the highlight never moves or is not visibly different
test_cases.observed_result: the filled icon and dark label moved to Recent, Favorite and Tools in turn and back to Home; the top header read "PDF Reader" on all four tabs; Recent and Favorite showed the same file-access prompt as Home, so the highlighted tab was the only thing telling them apart

test_cases.action: scroll the content down twice (past any crawl distance), then scroll back up; repeated on the Tools tab, the longest tab
test_cases.expected_result: the header and tab bar either stay, or leave and return
test_cases.confirms_if: the tab bar or its active state leaves the viewport and does not return
test_cases.overturns_if: the tab bar and its active state stay on screen throughout
test_cases.observed_result: on Home and on Tools the top "PDF Reader" bar collapsed out of view when scrolling down and came back on scrolling up; the bottom tab bar and its highlighted item stayed on screen throughout; Tools also pinned its current section name ("Convert") at the top while scrolled. Recorded as a note -- no scroll transition is in the manifest

deciding_evidence: the tab-bar highlight moves with the user to every tab and survives scrolling (s4-tc1, s4-tc2); the header is only the app's name and the pill row is a filter, so the tab bar alone carries the location
